0022600088.text: Both the Chicago Bulls and Toronto Raptors open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Bulls on the road. Chicago is without Dailyn Swain, Jordan Hawkins, and Nic Claxton, who are all out, and Isaac Okoro, Tobe Awaka, and Zach Collins are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Nate Bittle, who is day-to-day with a foot injury. In the 2025-26 season series, the Bulls lost 0-3, including a 139-109 loss in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
